raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including fever, anosmia, and shortness of breath, combined with the nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction, are highly suggestive of COVID-19. The presence of bilateral multifocal pneumonia on chest radiography further supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Community-acquired pneumonia
rejected.why: While the patient has symptoms and radiographic findings consistent with pneumonia, the specific combination of anosmia, positive reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction, and the context of the presentation point more strongly towards COVID-19.
